name: Celsius Resources Limited
summary: Celsius Resources Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration and extraction of mineral in Australia and Namibia. It holds a 95% interest in the Opuwo cobalt project comprising 3 exclusive prospecting licenses covering an area of approximately 1,106 square kilometers located in northwestern Namibia. The company also has an interest in two nickel assets in Western Australia, including a 100% interest in the Abednegno Hill nickel project and a 30% joint venture interest in the Carnilya Hill Joint Venture. The company was formerly known as Celsius Coal Limited and changed its name to Celsius Resources Limited in December 2016. Celsius Resources Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Perth, Australia.
